title: Experts disagree on tests/e2e/stage-enforcement-contract.e2e.test.ts
context:
Chief architect: This is the most testable claim and includes the other two: the same cases run on all three routes and only the organization sentence may differ. The single parameterised table (solution-architect) is how to build it. The Windows point (devops) is real and is listed as a gap, because the command prefix fixed in the request is POSIX shell syntax.

Target: tests/e2e/stage-enforcement-contract.e2e.test.ts
- devops-engineer: the managed route case runs on the ubuntu, macOS and Windows CI pipeline jobs; PAQAD_MANAGED=1 as a command prefix is POSIX shell syntax and may not run as written on Windows managed settings
- solution-architect: the managed route is a third parameterised route over the same case table, not a copied suite, so npm, plugin and managed cannot diverge
- qa-engineer: given the existing contract cases, when run on the npm, plugin and new managed (`paqad-ai hook`) routes, then every case yields the same exit code, stdout and stderr per route, with the only allowed difference being the managed stderr suffix `This rule is enforced by your organization's settings.`; proof_type e2e, cases unchanged
